turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I've been tweaking the monitoring for the Endpoint. I decided to use an Endpoint-informed angular-deviation signal over embedded reasoning/turn steps to flag backtracking.
That sounds like a sophisticated approach for detecting logic loops. Did you notice any false positives with that method?
A few, but mostly manageable. Also, did my order for the mechanical keyboard switches arrive yet?
I don't have access to your shipping info, but you can check the carrier's site.
Right. Back to the signal, it seems stable enough for now.
Good to hear. Let me know if you need help visualizing the deviation metrics.
Lloyd, I'm cleaning up the API docs. Just so we're clear on terminology: An Endpoint is a specific URL path and HTTP method combination that performs a particular operation.
Noted. That's the standard definition. Are you updating the swagger file?
Yes, mostly. Also, is it going to rain this weekend? I want to plan the barbecue.
The forecast shows a 40% chance of rain on Saturday, so maybe keep the grill covered.
Okay, I'll check the radar again later.
Sounds good. Let me know if you need help parsing the JSON schema for the new endpoints.
